info.title: Aura Admin API
info.description: TCP + bearer-token surface: config, jobs, cron, memory, traces, skills, tools, channels, LLM.

schema.description:
Envelope for list endpoints. `next_cursor` is opaque — clients
pass it back as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page, and treat
`None` as "no more pages." The cursor's internal scheme may change
across releases; clients must not parse it.

items.description: Read-only snapshot of a single registered channel.

parameters.name: include_hidden
parameters.description: Include hidden sessions in the response. Defaults to false.

500.description: Session creation or token mint failed

parameters.name: before_ordinal
parameters.description:
Return only rows whose `ordinal` is strictly less than this
value. Omit on the initial fetch; pass the lowest ordinal from
the prior page to scroll further back. Maps to a primary-key
range scan over the `session_messages` active index.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Maximum rows to return. Defaults to
[`DEFAULT_HISTORY_LIMIT`], clamped to [`MAX_HISTORY_LIMIT`].

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Session id whose token to refresh

parameters.name: session
parameters.description:
Restrict to a single session. Hits the per-session index in
the store instead of scanning the full jobs table.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Restrict to one terminal/in-flight status discriminator.
Snake-case, matching `JobStatusKind` (`pending`, `in_progress`,
`stuck`, `cancelled`, `failed`, `completed`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 50; capped at 500.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`.

AnalyticsDayBucket.description:
One bucket per UTC day for the analytics chart.

`cost_micro_usd` is integer micro-USD (USD × 10^6). Rendering layers
divide by 1_000_000 to get USD; on-wire arithmetic stays exact.

cost_micro_usd.description: Spend for the day, in **micro-USD** (1 USD = 1_000_000).

AnalyticsModelBucket.description: Per-model breakdown row for the analytics dashboard.

cost_micro_usd.description: Spend for the model, in **micro-USD** (1 USD = 1_000_000).

since.description: Inclusive lower bound used for the aggregation (UTC).

total_cost_micro_usd.description: Total spend across the window, in **micro-USD** (1 USD = 1_000_000).

until.description: Exclusive upper bound used for the aggregation (UTC).

ChannelType.description:
Admin-surface mirror of [`aura_model::ChannelType`]. Transparent
wrapper around a snake_case string so the OpenAPI surface stays
stable while the core type is open-ended (runtime-registered
sidecars like `"slack"` pass through unchanged).

ChatSessionCredential.description:
Response from `POST /v1/chat/sessions` and the
`POST /v1/chat/sessions/:id/token` token-refresh endpoint. Carries
the freshly-minted channel-token the web client presents on its
`/v1/channel-ws` upgrade via the
[`CHANNEL_TOKEN_HEADER`](crate::auth::CHANNEL_TOKEN_HEADER) header
(or the `?token=` query when the browser's WebSocket API can't set
custom headers — which it never can).

channel_token.description:
Capability token bound to a `web/<uuid>` identity. Live for the
lifetime of the session row; calling
`POST /v1/chat/sessions/:id/token` revokes the previous token
and returns a new one.

channel_token_header.description:
Header name the web client must use when presenting the
channel-token on the channel listener.

has_more.description:
`true` when at least one older active row exists below the
slice's lowest ordinal — i.e. the client should keep
scroll-up pagination armed. `false` when the slice already
includes the session's first message.

transcript.description:
Active transcript slice, oldest-first within the page. The
server returns at most `limit` rows; older rows are fetched
by passing the lowest `ordinal` here back as the next
request's `before_ordinal`.

hidden.description:
True when the user has hidden this session from their chat
list. Only ever populated in responses when
`include_hidden=true` was requested.

last_user_text.description:
Preview text drawn from the session's most-recent user-authored
message, truncated to [`PREVIEW_MAX_CHARS`]. The web sidebar
renders this as the row label so users can scan past
conversations by what they last asked. `None` for sessions
without a user turn yet (a freshly-created row, or one whose
transcript holds only system/tool rows).

ChatTranscriptItem.description:
One transcript row, flattened from `ChatMessage` into a shape the
web client can render without re-implementing the content-block
matcher.

created_at.description:
Wall-clock time the row was persisted, sourced from
`session_messages.created_at`. Lets the client render a
per-message timestamp without a second lookup. Live WS frames
don't carry this — the web client falls back to the receive
time for those, which is close enough for live emissions and
drifts only on catch-up replays (where the row is also
reachable via the REST history surface with the real value).

has_attachments.description:
`true` when this row had non-text content (image / audio /
file). The web client currently shows a placeholder.

ordinal.description:
Absolute `session_messages.ordinal` of this row. Stable for the
lifetime of the session and used both as a React key and as
the `before_ordinal` cursor for the next-older page request.

role.description:
`"user"` or `"assistant"` (or `"system"`). String rather than
enum to keep the wire forgiving.

text.description:
Plain text content, newline-joined when multiple text blocks
were present. Empty when the message was media-only.

CreateCronRequest.description:
`POST /v1/cron` body. Schedule format is the standard 5-field cron
string accepted by [`aura_cron`].

timezone.description:
IANA timezone (e.g. `"Asia/Shanghai"`) used to evaluate the cron
expression and to render time fields in responses. Required —
every time the API speaks is anchored to this zone, so callers
must commit to one explicitly.

ErrorBody.description:
Uniform error envelope for every non-2xx admin response.

`GatewayError::into_response` already emits `{"error": "..."}`; this
type just pins the shape in the spec so clients can discriminate on
it rather than on status codes alone.

Job.description:
Wire mirror of [`aura_job::Job`]. Inner shape reflects the new
state machine (Q6) — `final_result` replaces `output`/`error`,
`emitted_span_ids` replaces `trace_span_id`.

JobStatus.description:
Wire mirror of [`aura_job::JobStatus`]. Carries the same payload
the domain enum carries (cancel reason, partial-artifact span IDs);
the wire shape collapses inner-variant content into `Option`-typed
fields so HTTP clients can decode without needing the full Rust
enum machinery.

ListResponse_SlashCommandEntry.description:
Envelope for list endpoints. `next_cursor` is opaque — clients
pass it back as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page, and treat
`None` as "no more pages." The cursor's internal scheme may change
across releases; clients must not parse it.

items.description:
Wire DTO for slash command entries. Mirror of
[`aura_channels::wire::SlashCommandSpec`] so the OpenAPI surface
stays inside this crate's DTOs (the wire type lives in
`aura-channels` for sidecar reuse).

LlmModelEntry.description:
One row in `GET /v1/llm/models`. Carries both the raw config (so the
edit form can populate "override or unset" toggles) and the
**effective** values that result from layering overrides over the
factory / OpenRouter snapshot defaults.

api_key_configured.description:
`true` when an API key is currently resolvable for this entry
(vault entry, explicit `api_key_env`, or provider-default env
var). The literal value never leaves the gateway.

effective_context_window.description:
Effective `context_window` that the runtime would observe given
the current overrides and snapshot/factory defaults.

oneOf.description: Operator override for pricing fields. `None` = factory default.

LlmModelPricingDto.description:
Effective per-token pricing for a model after applying any operator
overrides — micro-USD per 1M tokens.

LlmModelTestResult.description:
`POST /v1/llm/models/{name}/test` response. Carries the latency and
token usage from a one-shot `ping` probe.

error.description:
On `ok: false`, a human-readable error suitable for direct
display (auth failure, network error, etc.).

latency_ms.description: Round-trip latency in ms (only on success).

provider.description:
Provider id used for the probe (may differ from the request's
`name` if the entry's provider was just edited).

LlmModelUsage.description:
One row in `GET /v1/llm/usage` — aggregated cost / token volume for
a single configured entry, joined by `entry.model == record.model`.

model.description: The `model` id used to look up records.

name.description: Entry `name`. May be unique per (provider, model) pair.

LlmPricingOverrideDto.description:
Per-entry pricing override fields. Wire shape mirrors
[`aura_model::LlmPricingOverride`]; each field is integer micro-USD
per 1M tokens (1 USD = 1_000_000). The DTO exists separately from
the canonical struct only so we can derive `ToSchema` for utoipa
without leaking that derive into `aura-model`.

since.description: Inclusive lower bound of the aggregation window.

LogEntry.description:
Mirror of [`crate::log_buffer::LogRecord`]. Used as the item type of
[`LogsResponse`].

target.description:
Tracing target that emitted the record (e.g.
`aura_gateway::server`). Rendered as "source" in the UI.

LogField.description:
Single structured tracing field (`k=v`) captured alongside a log
record. Kept as free-form strings — formatting / unquoting happens
in the emitter.

LogLevel.description:
Mirror of [`crate::log_buffer::LogLevel`]. Snake-cased on the wire to
match the rest of the admin surface.

LogsResponse.description:
Envelope for `GET /v1/logs`. Unlike [`ListResponse`] we expose
`total` so the UI can render pagination (`Showing X of N`).

total.description:
Total number of records matching the filters — independent of
`limit`/`offset`, so clients can size the pager without asking
for the full list.

SessionKind.description:
Wire mirror of [`aura_query::SessionKind`]. Coarse trigger/lineage
label for the trace browser list view.

value.description: JSON value written at `path`. Shape validated by `AuraConfig`.

SlashCommandEntry.description:
Wire DTO for slash command entries. Mirror of
[`aura_channels::wire::SlashCommandSpec`] so the OpenAPI surface
stays inside this crate's DTOs (the wire type lives in
`aura-channels` for sidecar reuse).

TraceSessionSummary.description:
One row of the trace browser list view. Mirrors
[`aura_query::SessionSummary`] for the wire.

oneOf.description:
`None` when the session has no jobs (those rows are filtered
out, but the type stays Option to keep the wire shape stable
if the policy ever flips).

TracesListResponse.description:
Envelope for `GET /v1/traces`. Carries `total` for "Showing X of N"
pagers, matching the shape of [`LogsResponse`].

UpdateLlmModelRequest.description:
`PUT /v1/llm/models/{name}` body. Every field is optional — only
present fields are applied. To clear an override pass an explicit
`null` (handled by including the key in the request JSON; serde
can't distinguish "missing key" from "key with null" by default, so
the handler treats `Some(None)` as clear and an absent key as keep).

api_key.description:
Set the literal API key in the vault (`llm.entry.<name>.api_key`).
Pass `""` to remove the vault entry, or omit the field to leave
the vault untouched. Never echoed back.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable name holding the API key, or `null` to clear.

base_url.description: Custom base URL or `null` to clear.

model.description: Set the model id (e.g. `"gpt-4o"`). Requires gateway restart.

provider.description: Set the provider id (e.g. `"openai"`). Requires gateway restart.
